Compliance is not represented by an unsupported percentage.

risks: Static lexical source analysis is not a penetration test or compliance certification.
Very large repository audits are bounded; incomplete runs must be reported as incomplete.
A competing Railway-connected deployment path can post contradictory status and should be disabled.
Selling unverified unlimited/full audits before new coverage cost validation could create margin and reliability risk.
